title: RAW UNREVIEWED: parent bulb and detachable daughter offsets
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. Seek a dated gardening or herbal primary that names a parent bulb and its detachable offsets and distinguishes their planting from seed sowing. An admitted target would need an identifiable bulb-with-offset drawing and at least two locally owned written units, with a second owned crop record to separate kinship from a generic plant opener. No botanical taxon or word is inferred here.

design.unit: complete botanical entry with owned parent, offset and propagation references
design.contrast: daughter-offset relation versus seed or ordinary root part list
design.prediction: fixed candidate whole forms preserve the source's parent and offspring role asymmetry across two independently owned records
